name: stellarclear-monorepo
description: Open-source Stellar-native settlement evidence and reconciliation protocol

scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && node --test tests/dist/*.test.js tests/dist/**/*.test.js
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && node --test tests/dist/schemas.test.js tests/dist/proof.test.js tests/dist/matcher.test.js tests/dist/db*.test.js tests/dist/sdk*.test.js tests/dist/settlement-registry.test.js
scripts.test:api: npm run build && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && node --test tests/dist/api*.test.js
scripts.test:indexer: npm run build && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && node --test tests/dist/indexer*.test.js
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && node --test tests/dist/integration/**/*.test.js
